evidence: WHO states IITT is intended for facility-based triage and uses red/yellow/green acuity categories.
dataset_action: Do not claim the app implements WHO triage; use WHO-informed/guideline-derived wording.

evidence: WHO red denotes high acuity; the adult IITT lists multiple RED criteria.
dataset_action: Target renamed/interpreted narrowly: presence of at least one of five selected mapped RED signs, not the full IITT RED category.

evidence: Unresponsive is directly listed among adult IITT RED criteria.
Adult IITT uses respiratory distress or central cyanosis; WHO reference card provides supporting definitions.
dataset_action: Rename feature to respiratory_distress_or_cyanosis; UI may simplify wording but report preserves canonical source term.

evidence: Heavy bleeding is directly listed as an adult IITT RED criterion.
Source term is active convulsions, not generic seizure history.
dataset_action: Replace training feature seizure with active_convulsions; app alias seizure is allowed only when it means active current convulsions.

evidence: Adult IITT lists high-risk trauma; reference card defines examples.
dataset_action: Replace training feature major_trauma with high_risk_trauma and require UI helper examples.

evidence: Mobility/walking is triage-relevant, but MC-IITT red additionally requires critical signs and the v5 binary target is selected RED-sign presence.
dataset_action: Remove cannot_move from LR training features; retain only as structured context in the app/source registry.

evidence: The source tools triage individual patients; the rescue app may represent a group.
dataset_action: Master CSV explicitly states group-level OR semantics: a flag is 1 if at least one person in the report has the sign. This is project adaptation, not source-validated.

evidence: Rows are protocol states, not narrative cases.
dataset_action: Final training rows are generated by deterministic exhaustive 2^5 enumeration; no LLM, random sampling or free-form scenario generation.
